cases.name: defaults
cases.encryptConfig:
<project outputDir="${root}" baseDir="${root}" xmlns="http://confuser.codeplex.com">
	<!-- 未启用任何 protection 规则，仅做打包 -->
	<packer id="compressor" />
	<module path="${exe}" />
</project>
cases.packageScript:
; SealPack 打包脚本（Inno Setup）
; 本文件由界面上的选项生成；在「高级」里直接编辑后会转为自定义模式。
; 占位符使用 ${key} 语法，执行时会被替换为工程实际值

#define MyAppName "${name}"
#define MyAppVersion "${version}"
#define MyAppExeName "${exe}"
#define MyAppPublisher "hmilyld"
#define MyAppURL "https://hmilyld.com/"

[Setup]
AppId={{${id}
AppName={#MyAppName}
AppVersion={#MyAppVersion}
AppPublisher={#MyAppPublisher}
AppPublisherURL={#MyAppURL}
AppSupportURL={#MyAppURL}
AppUpdatesURL={#MyAppURL}
DefaultDirName={autopf}\{#MyAppName}
DisableProgramGroupPage=yes
PrivilegesRequired=lowest
OutputDir=${output}
OutputBaseFilename={#MyAppName}-安装包-{#MyAppVersion}
Compression=lzma2/max
SolidCompression=yes
LZMAMatchFinder=BT
Password=${password}
Encryption=yes
EncryptionKeyDerivation=pbkdf2/220000
WizardStyle=modern

[Languages]
Name: "chinesesimplified"; MessagesFile: "ChineseSimplified.isl"

[Tasks]
Name: "desktopicon"; Description: "{cm:CreateDesktopIcon}"; GroupDescription: "{cm:AdditionalIcons}"; Flags: unchecked

[Files]
Source: "${root}\${exe}"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
Source: "${root}\*"; Excludes: "${ignore},${exe}"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion recursesubdirs createallsubdirs

[Icons]
Name: "{autoprograms}\{#MyAppName}"; Filename: "{app}\{#MyAppExeName}"
Name: "{autodesktop}\{#MyAppName}"; Filename: "{app}\{#MyAppExeName}"; Tasks: desktopicon

[Run]
Filename: "{app}\{#MyAppExeName}"; Description: "{cm:LaunchProgram,{#StringChange(MyAppName, '&', '&&')}}"; Flags: nowait postinstall skipifsilent

cases.name: anti-family
cases.encryptConfig:
<project outputDir="${root}" baseDir="${root}" xmlns="http://confuser.codeplex.com">
	<rule pattern="true" preset="normal" inherit="false">
		<protection id="anti ildasm" />
		<protection id="anti debug">
			<argument name="mode" value="win32" />
		</protection>
		<protection id="anti dump" />
		<protection id="anti tamper">
			<argument name="mode" value="jit" />
			<argument name="key" value="dynamic" />
		</protection>
		<protection id="invalid metadata" />
		<protection id="harden" />
	</rule>
	<packer id="compressor" />
	<module path="${exe}" />
</project>
